name: Melodiana
source:
Melodiana is an angel Wil meets after making an offering at a Cliffside Church. She subsequently joins Wil and company under the premise of monitoring him. Melodiana tells Wil that she is an apsael archangel, which despite the grand sounding name, is actually the second lowest rank among the 9 ranks of angels.

[From [url=http://eushully.wikia.com]Eushully Wikia[/url]]
